tasks.description: Optimize frontend code to reduce load times and improve responsiveness. Focus on reducing unnecessary HTTP requests and minifying CSS/JS files. Use tools like Webpack and Babel to optimize code.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user navigates to the homepage, when the page loads, then the load time is under 2 seconds

tasks.description: Implement caching mechanisms to reduce database queries and improve response times. Use a caching library like Redis or Memcached to store frequently accessed data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user makes a repeated request, when the cache is enabled, then the response time is reduced by 50%

tasks.description: Identify and fix indexing issues in the database to improve query performance. Use tools like EXPLAIN and ANALYZE to identify bottlenecks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user runs a query, when the indexing is optimized, then the query time is reduced by 30%

tasks.description: Develop a dashboard to track and monitor performance metrics such as load times, response times, and error rates. Use tools like Grafana or New Relic to visualize data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user views the dashboard, when the data is up-to-date, then the user can see current performance metrics

tasks.description: Migrate the application to faster storage solutions such as SSDs to improve disk I/O performance. Research and recommend the best storage options for the application.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user accesses data, when the storage is migrated, then the access time is reduced by 40%

tasks.description: Develop automated testing scripts to simulate user interactions and measure performance. Use tools like JMeter or Gatling to simulate load and stress test the application.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user runs the test script, when the test is completed, then the performance metrics are reported

tasks.description: Establish a code review process to ensure that all code changes are reviewed for performance impact. Develop guidelines and checklists for reviewers to follow.
acceptance_criteria: Given a developer submits code, when the code is reviewed, then the reviewer checks for performance impact
